title: Add staggered init framework and namespace-rotation support to private helm chart
author: Priya Kaur
release_notes: Introduces a new 'stagedInit' values block to support staggered init jobs, optional namespace rotation strategy, and a compatibility shim for existing init configs. Includes helm template tests and a migration note for operators
description:
Summary: Adds a new 'stagedInit' framework to the private helm chart to support staggered, rate-limited init jobs across namespaces and an optional namespace-rotation strategy for safer upgrades.
Motivation: Customers running large multi-tenant on-prem clusters encountered timeouts and DB migration contention during simultaneous init jobs when performing upgrades. This change introduces a controlled cadence and per-wave concurrency to reduce resource spikes and allows a namespace rotation option to stagger tenant readiness without manual intervention.
High-level changes:
1) values schema: introduce 'stagedInit' with fields: enabled, waves (array reference), concurrencyPerWave, cadenceMs, leaderElect, preflightProbe, rotationStrategy (none|sequential|round-robin), migrationSafeMode boolean, compatV1 shim.
2) templates: new helpers/_staged-init.tpl to render N initJobs based on waves and to inject annotations for rotation tokens; conditional leader election support for init-controller jobs; templated preflight probe job generation that gates a wave until resource checks pass.
3) charts: update NOTES.txt to document stagedInit usage and migration steps; add examples/staged-init-values.yaml.
4) compatibility: add values parsing shim so existing 'init' top-level keys are accepted and mapped to stagedInit for a zero-downtime upgrade path.
5) tests: add helm template unit tests and a lightweight k8s-kind CI job that runs the generated init jobs in dry-run mode.
6) docs: brief upgrade note for operators and a sample migration script.
Commits:
- 7db3f2c: introduce stagedInit values schema and default values
- d14a8e1: add template helpers and init job generator
- a8f7c3b: implement namespace-rotation annotations and token reconciler hooks
- c22d9f0: compatibility shim to map legacy 'init' config to stagedInit
- e45b2aa: add helm unit tests and NOTES examples
- f90b1d4: fix lint issues and CI test flakiness
Context and rationale: Prior attempts to sequence init jobs via external orchestration increased operator complexity. The goal here is to keep sequencing logic inside the chart so installs/upgrades are self-contained and portable for private installs. The rotationStrategy and reconciliation annotations are intentionally conservative: default is 'none' to preserve current behavior. For clusters that want rolling tenant readiness we recommend 'sequential' with small waves and a conservative cadenceMs.
Reviewed changes and notable diffs (high-level file list):
- charts/private/templates/_staged-init.tpl (new)

Design choices:
- cadenceMs expressed in milliseconds for fine-grained control and compatibility with existing scheduling primitives.
- concurrencyPerWave is a simple integer to bound parallelism per wave; it maps to parallelism in Job spec when supported.
- leaderElect default true for clusters with controller-manager to avoid collisions; can be disabled in resource-constrained environments.
- migrationSafeMode toggles additional preflight checks (resourceQuota, DB connectivity) before starting migrations.
Backwards compatibility: A compat shim accepts legacy keys (init.enabled, init.jobs[]) and maps them into stagedInit.waves with a single wave preserving previous semantics. Operators are recommended to run scripts/migrate-init-values.sh to convert values in CI/CD pipelines prior to upgrading.
CI and testing: Initial CI run failed lint (helm lint checks around values.schema.json strictness) and a helm-templating unit test flaked under the kind job (timing sensitive).
Fixes: relaxed one validation rule (allow null for rotationStrategy if not enabled) and added a small sleep/retry in the test harness. After changes the full pipeline passed.
Test coverage: new unit tests cover wave generation, leaderElect toggles, and legacy mapping. The kind dry-run validates Job manifests render with correct annotations.
Security and safety: No new cluster-level permissions were added beyond existing Job and ConfigMap rights. The init jobs continue to run as non-root and reuse the existing service account.
release_notes: Adds staged init orchestration and namespace rotation support. Migration notes included.
Review conversation (selected excerpts):
- Ethan Liu (reviewer): "Main suggestion: add defensive guards in the template so that missing cadenceMs doesn't produce a malformed Cron-like field in the job name." Author response: "Added default cadenceMs=60000 and explicit toInt calls in the template to avoid that exact issue."
- Marco Alvarez: "We should avoid adding an implicit leaderElect when k8s <=1.24 clusters are in use; maybe expose a toggle defaulting to false for older clusters." Author: "Added 'leaderElectLegacyCompatibility' flag and documented it in README-operators.md."
- Sasha Ivanov: "CI flaked on kind timings; consider replacing the sleep with a probe loop." Author: "Reworked test harness to poll for rendered objects and removed brittle sleeps."
- Marco Alvarez (approval): "LGTM after minor docs tweak."
Approvals and status:
- Requested changes addressed.
- Approvals: Marco Alvarez (approved), Ethan Liu (approved), Sasha Ivanov (approved).
- Final CI: all checks passed.
Merge: squash merge into main on 2026-02-20 by Priya Kaur.
Deployment notes: Operators should patch their helmfile/terraform modules to set stagedInit.enabled=true and run scripts/migrate-init-values.sh in CI before performing a large-scale upgrade. If using rotationStrategy=round-robin enable migrationSafeMode=true for additional DB gating.
Files changed summary (counts): 14 files changed, +820 additions, -212 deletions.
Follow-ups and future work:
- Add an operator-mode controller that can hold state across waves for very large clusters (separate RFC).
- Provide a terraform module example that exposes stagedInit config through a top-level variable for private installs.
- Add telemetry (metrics) for waves started/completed to the console in a follow-up PR.
